name: series
doc: Package series keeps a list of integer samples and computes statistics over it.

funcs.name: Push
funcs.doc: Push appends v and returns the new length.

funcs.name: Sum
funcs.doc: Sum adds every value; the sum wraps on overflow.

funcs.name: Sorted
funcs.doc: Sorted returns the values in ascending order, by insertion sort; the series is unchanged.

funcs.name: Reverse
funcs.doc: Reverse reverses the series in place.

funcs.name: MaxWindow
funcs.doc: MaxWindow is the largest sum of w consecutive values.

funcs.name: Gcd
funcs.doc: Gcd is the greatest common divisor of every value, 0 for an empty series.

funcs.name: Drop
funcs.doc: Drop removes every value equal to v and returns how many it removed.

funcs.name: Steps
funcs.doc: Steps counts the Collatz steps from n to 1, stopping at maxSteps.

funcs.name: Bucket
funcs.doc: Bucket names the size class of v.

funcs.name: Residue
funcs.doc: Residue names v modulo 3, with Go's sign: the remainder takes the sign of v.
